company.zh: 佳为工程勘察测绘有限公司

text.en: Enterprise-grade bilingual RAG Agent delivery: Led the knowledge QA Agent for internal business and customer support, solving the problem of mixed Chinese-English surveying standards and historical project documents that were difficult to retrieve.
text.zh: 企业级双语 RAG Agent 落地：主导面向内部业务与客服的知识问答 Agent，解决测绘规范与历史项目文档中英混排、检索困难的问题。

text.en: High-availability inference architecture and compute deployment: Responsible for the decoupled service architecture based on FastAPI + TEI, as well as the Docker-based orchestration of a 4 × NVIDIA L20 GPU server, supporting production deployment.
text.zh: 高可用推理架构与算力部署：负责 FastAPI + TEI 解耦的服务化架构，以及 4 × NVIDIA L20 GPU 服务器的 Docker 化编排，支撑生产环境部署。

position.zh: AI 应用与全栈开发实习生

text.en: Inquiry-based AI teaching assistant and context engineering: Orchestrated a Llama workflow with n8n, maintained multi-turn conversation context via session_id, and concatenated conversation history with the latest reply into the recommended-question prompt to generate guided follow-up questions instead of direct answers.
text.zh: 探究式 AI 助教与上下文工程：基于 n8n 编排 Llama 工作流，用 session_id 维护多轮对话上下文，并把对话历史与最新回复拼接进推荐问题 Prompt，生成引导式追问而不是直接给答案。

text.en: Multi-stage study workflow loop: Led the platform from a half-finished state to production launch, building the state-transition chain across 8 learning stages with React 19 + TypeScript, connecting the student learning process with teacher-side grading and evaluation.
text.zh: 多阶段研学工作流闭环：主导平台从半成品到生产上线，用 React 19 + TypeScript 构建贯穿 8 个学习阶段的状态流转链路，打通学生学习过程与教师端批改评价环节。

text.en: Full-stack type contracts and automated delivery: Used tRPC + shared types to eliminate frontend-backend interface integration errors, modeled business and conversation data with Prisma; configured Git Hooks to automatically trigger builds and PM2 restarts, establishing a standardized release process.
text.zh: 全栈类型契约与自动化交付：以 tRPC + 共享类型消除前后端接口联调误差，结合 Prisma 完成业务与对话数据建模；配置 Git Hook 自动触发构建与 PM2 重启，沉淀标准化发布流程。

text.en: Large-scale spatial data governance and analytics platform: Contributed to the Global EV Data Initiative, built a pipeline to normalize multi-source heterogeneous EV charging-station data into standard spatial data, and developed a dynamic geospatial analytics dashboard, accumulating spatial data engineering foundations for domain-specific Spatial Agents.
text.zh: 大规模空间数据治理与分析平台：参与 Global EV Data Initiative，构建管线把多源异构充电桩数据归一为标准空间数据，并开发动态地理分析仪表盘，为垂直领域 Spatial Agent 积累空间数据工程基础。

text.en: To address the high barrier to GIS analysis, designed a strongly typed Tool-Use architecture based on Pydantic AI: wrapped operators such as spatial queries and buffer analysis into standardized tools, enabling the Agent to autonomously decompose intent and dispatch tools, and outputting validated GeoJSON and analysis reports.
text.zh: 面向 GIS 分析门槛高的问题，基于 Pydantic AI 设计强类型 Tool-Use 架构：把空间查询、缓冲区分析等算子封装为标准化工具，Agent 自主拆解意图并调度工具，输出经校验的 GeoJSON 与分析报告。

text.en: Staged streaming status feedback: For time-consuming spatial computing scenarios, used SSE to push intent parsing, tool execution and rendering status in stages; the frontend incrementally renders layers via Deck.gl / MapLibre with deduplication and metadata management, balancing smooth interaction with traceable results.
text.zh: 分阶段流式状态反馈：针对空间计算耗时长的场景，用 SSE 分阶段推送意图解析、工具执行与渲染状态；前端通过 Deck.gl / MapLibre 增量渲染图层，并做去重与元数据管理，兼顾交互流畅与结果可追溯。

name.zh: 企业级 RAG 知识库引擎

text.en: High-precision document ETL and hybrid chunking: Used Docling to clean thousands of unstructured enterprise PDF / Word documents into hierarchy-preserving Markdown, applied HybridChunker to chunk by semantic and structural boundaries, then batch-encoded and idempotently wrote to Qdrant via deterministic IDs.
text.zh: 高精度文档 ETL 与混合分块：基于 Docling 把企业内部数千份 PDF / Word 等非结构化文档清洗为保留层级的 Markdown，用 HybridChunker 结合语义与结构边界分块，批量编码后通过确定性 ID 幂等写入 Qdrant。

text.en: Agentic query rewriting and concurrent retrieval: To bridge the semantic gap in cross-lingual retrieval, used a Qwen Agent to generate at least 2 Chinese-English bilingual queries before retrieval, concurrently recalled Top-K chunks from Qdrant and deduplicated by ID, enforcing answers with source attribution and confidence scores.
text.zh: Agentic Query 改写与并发召回：为缓解跨语言检索的语义鸿沟，用 Qwen Agent 在检索前生成至少 2 组中英双语 Query，并发召回 Qdrant Top-K 切片并按 ID 去重，强制输出带原文溯源与置信度的回答。

text.en: High-concurrency deployment with separated storage and compute: Deployed BGE-M3 embedding inference independently with TEI, decoupled from the stateless FastAPI Agent gateway; the vector store is persisted with snapshot recovery, and encoding, retrieval and generation nodes can scale independently.
text.zh: 存算分离的高并发部署：用 TEI 独立部署 BGE-M3 向量推理服务，与无状态 FastAPI Agent 网关解耦；向量库持久化并支持快照恢复，编码、检索与生成节点可独立扩容。

desc.en: Visualizing 100,000+ points using advanced spatial clustering.
desc.zh: 利用空间聚类算法展示全球 10w+ 充电桩分布。

desc.en: Real-time parsing of 1GB+ trajectory data using WebWorkers.
desc.zh: 通过 WebWorker 异步解析 1GB+ 的巴士轨迹时空数据。

desc.en: Hybrid 3D map using DeckGL and OpenStreetMap building data.
desc.zh: 结合 DeckGL 与 OSM 构建的 3D 混合虚拟校园地图。
